title: NAIRA Bill — National Artificial Intelligence Regulation Authority
keywords: NAIRA National Artificial Intelligence Regulation Authority December 2024 February 2025 Luminary Technicals 45 days CIMS full form unconfirmed rate reduction up to 30 percent tender March 2029 annual budget management allocation DRDO Defence Research and Development Organisation SET Social Engineering Toolkit Social-Engineer Toolkit distinction exclusive research
text: The supplied NAIRA project account records December 2024 as the bill regulation date, a February 2025 handover to Luminary Technicals, a working system within 45 days, and a reported CIMS rate reduction of up to 30% on day one. It describes a programme through March 2029, budget figures, an arrangement involving 12 private companies and DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation), and exclusive Social Engineering Toolkit (SET) research assigned to Luminary Technicals. SET here means the distinct unhyphenated Social Engineering Toolkit concept, not the established Social-Engineer Toolkit. CIMS full form is not provided and is not guessed.
